evidence: Wrote tests/test_record_join.py first. The first run failed at collection (ModuleNotFoundError, no record_join). I then wrote scripts/record_join.py. `python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_record_join.py` gives 5 passed. The tests cover the five-record fixture, inclusive window edges, a session with a missing window, recorded_at as an ISO string, and ids-only output. Nothing is committed. I did not touch .artifacts/ or other tests.
observations: join(sessions, records) returns {"by_session": {sid: {"records": [...], "ambiguous": [...]}}, "unattached": [...]}. Every session stays in by_session. Sessions without start or end get nothing. A record in two or more windows goes into "records" and "ambiguous" of each one. The session cwd basename is matched against record["store"]. recorded_at accepts a datetime or an ISO string, and a naive value is treated as UTC. An unparseable ISO string raises ValueError.
